title: Data Synthesis using CTGAN, and TabDDPM
summary: A small research project that synthesizes tabular performance/power measurement data (occupancy, ILP, hit rates, power metrics) using CTGAN and a diffusion model as alternative augmentation methods. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with a SingleTableMetadata schema and evaluates the synthetic output with SDV's evaluate_quality and run_diagnostic diagnostics.
evidence: CTGAN.py:18 synthesizer = CTGANSynthesizer(metadata,verbose=True, batch_size=64, ...); imports run_diagnostic, evaluate_quality
